avis.titre: Not much oil control to justify price...
avis.texte: I've been holding off on this review, hoping for something to justify its price. However, I have not found anything to do so. While its a good toner, its exactly that, just a good toner. I was using a drug store witch hazel toner before this. I have oily skin that does so much better without toner, letting my face wash and matching moisturizer do its thing. However, toner is a must to thoroughly clean your face and remove skin flaking (I use cvs brand exfoliating cotton rounds, nothing compares to them). I don't have acne, so I can't speak for that aspect. I can say I have noticed in comparison to the toner I was using prior, I blot my face less. However, I still have to blot all day, so this toner isn't really doing me much of a favor. And again, this is also combined with a great face wash and moisturizer for oily skin. Overall, I don't see the $22 price tag I bought it for as justifiable. I've used many oily skin products over the years, from drug store to department store; from my experience, this toner is over-priced. Maybe it will work for you, and work well for acne. For myself, I will be trying other brands in hope to one day find a toner that has real oil control. ----- Update: 12/9/25 - this bottle ran out weeks ago and I have not replaced with another toner. I have been only using my face wash and moisturizer (c r ve), both formulated for oily skin. My face has never been so oil-free for so many hours (I barely blot now). avis.titre: Paula’s Choice Skin Balancing Pore-Reducing Toner: A Must-Have for Oily & Combination Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Paula’s Choice Pore-Reducing Toner for a while, and it has made a noticeable difference in my skin. It’s designed for oily and combination skin, and it really helps control shine and minimize the appearance of pores. Pros: ✔ Lightweight & Hydrating – Unlike some toners that dry out the skin, this one keeps it balanced and refreshed. ✔ Controls Oil Without Stripping – My skin feels clean but not tight, which is perfect for oily areas. ✔ Niacinamide for Pore Refinement – Helps with skin texture, reduces redness, and minimizes the look of pores over time. ✔ Soothes & Calms Skin – Contains antioxidants and hydrating ingredients that help reduce irritation. Cons: ✖ Might Not Be Hydrating Enough for Dry Skin – If your skin leans more towards dry, this might not give you enough moisture. ✖ Results Take Time – Pore reduction isn’t instant, but with consistent use, you’ll see improvements. Final Thoughts: If you have oily or combination skin and want a light, non-irritating toner that helps with shine and pores, this is a great choice! It works well in a routine with other niacinamide or exfoliating products like BHA.

I’ve ordered this toner more times than I can count over the years, which probably says more about how much I like it than anything else. I have combination skin, so finding products that keep the oily parts of my face under control without making the drier areas feel tight can be challenging. This is one of the few toners I’ve consistently come back to. The formula is lightweight and absorbs almost immediately after application. It doesn’t leave behind any sticky residue or film, which is something I really appreciate in a toner. My skin feels refreshed and balanced after using it rather than stripped or overly dry. One of the biggest reasons I continue repurchasing it is how well it helps manage oil throughout the day. My T-zone tends to get shiny, especially during warmer months, and this helps keep that under control while still leaving the rest of my skin feeling hydrated and comfortable. The niacinamide is also a nice addition, and over time I’ve noticed my pores look less noticeable and my skin texture appears smoother. I also like that it’s fragrance-free and gentle enough for daily use. I’ve never experienced irritation from it, and it layers easily with serums, moisturizers, and sunscreen. It fits seamlessly into both my morning and evening routines. Bottom line: This is one of those products I keep returning to because it consistently delivers good results. It helps balance my combination skin, keeps excess oil in check, provides light hydration, and leaves my skin

Paula’s Choice Skin Balancing Pore-Reducer is an incredible product on its own, but using it alongside my Medicube Zero pore line has completely transformed my skin! This toner is amazing at balancing out my oily zones and providing lightweight, shine-free hydration with its niacinamide and ceramides. When paired with the exfoliating power of Medicube, my stubborn blackheads are gone, and my enlarged pores look practically invisible. The formula is super gentle, completely fragrance-free, and leaves my skin feeling incredibly smooth and refreshed without any tight or stripped feeling. If you are struggling with large pores and uneven texture, using Paula's Choice alongside Medicube is the ultimate skincare cheat code. I cannot recommend this combination enough!

This is the only product I have ever used that actually reduces pore size and does not break out my skin. I have used tons of different toners; Mary Kay, proactive, oil of Olay, face reality, medicube, pure witch hazel and rose water - this is the only product hat visibly shrinks the pores on my nose. I have very oily skin and very sensitive skin. So basically anything I use on my skin breaks it out. I got a travel size of this product after reading the reviews and desperately trying make my skin look less wrinkly and just crappy for an upcoming trip with my husband. Since it was a trial size, and available for return I thought what is the worst that could happen, I’ll try it on a little area and if it breaks my face out I’ll send it back. But I was AMAZED. I have had large sunken pore on my nose for about 20 years. No amount of pore strips, cleanser, toner - makes it smaller. But this product almost makes it completely disappear.. I don’t know how it works, because I do have to constantly use it daily to keep the same effect but I visibly lifts and tightens the area around that giant pore. More than satisfied and just ordered the full size bottle because I do not want to run out. If you have larger pores by this! I don’t bother taken a before / after - because I was skeptical but it really works.

Paula’s Choice toner is hands-down one of the best skincare products I’ve used. From the very first week, my skin felt calmer, smoother, and more balanced. It’s incredibly gentle yet effective—no stinging, no irritation, just clean, refreshed skin that actually feels cared for. What I love most is how lightweight it is. It absorbs quickly, layers beautifully with serums and moisturizers, and leaves my skin hydrated without any residue or tightness. Over time, I noticed improved texture, fewer clogged pores, and a healthier overall glow. The formula feels thoughtfully made—fragrance-free, non-drying, and perfect for daily use, even on sensitive skin. It truly preps my skin and makes the rest of my routine work better. If you’re looking for a toner that actually does something without being harsh, Paula’s Choice delivers. Worth every penny and a permanent staple in my skincare routine. I partner it with Paula’s Choice Exfoliant BHA Toner and my 40 year old skin feels and looks like my high school skin again!

avis.titre: Oily/combo/large pores/ mature skin thank me later. Any age thank me
avis.texte: Great product but pay attention to cost per ounce. I use Medicube for all my products (except eye patches), but nothing will ever replace Paula’s choice for my toner to keep skin clean, not dry, pores clear, and skin ready to absorb serums and masks, without stripping moisture or my barrier. I use many toners but all start and end with this. Red Succinic, collagen jelly, calming Cica and vitamin c are my daily in that order after this toner (cleanse, this toner with cotton then Medicube pads, then back to this poured in hands and patted into skin before any serum or mask. Non negotiable. 40 oily combo dry skin with large pores that are now clean and healthy thanks to a barrier regiment to keep skin moist and not letting actives drive the day made the difference, healthier and oil at bay, with this skin reboot, and reborn to my late 20s, without Botox or retinol

Here is a picture of what I use for my face which is both oily and dry. It has been hard finding the right face products for my skin. A lot of times it would clog my large pores, or I would have white heads along with dry/ red blotchy skin. Then I researched some of Paula’s Choice products. I picked out what I thought fit my type of skin. After some adjusting my skin has been the best it has ever been. I don’t have big blackheads, white heads, dry skin, or red blotches. And it feels great. In the morning I use the face wash, eye cream, and the daily hydrating fluid lotion. At night I use the face wash, the toner (make sure you let your face completely dry afterwards before moving on), I use 3 drops of the boost (let that dry), then I put on the night oil free moisturizer. Every Tuesday night I use the exfoliate instead of the toner. You let it dry completely. It takes about 15 minutes. I usually don’t put anything on after using the exfoliate because I am too tired to wait for it to dry. It works for me. Then about once a month or every two weeks on a Friday night, after using the toner, I use exfoliate rinse off treatment. Afterwards I finish with the boost and night moisturizer. I highly recommend this brand.

So, at the ripe old age of 36, I am feeling motivated to do something for my skin, as I don’t really wear makeup except for special occasions. For my entire life I have pretty much just used a facial cleanser and then a moisturizer. I have sensitive skin, so I’ve just always been a little nervous to try new stuff on it. But my friend overhauled her skin routine recently and was actually glowing, so I asked her about it. She suggested just adding a toner. I, of course, hit up some Amazon reviews and decided to try the Paula’s Choice Toner and the Paula’s Choice Exfoliator. Wow - my skin looks so smooth now!! My color is more even, and my pores are not as noticeable. My sister even commented on how different and brighter my skin was. The Exfoliator makes my skin itch, so I have dropped it the past couple months and I haven’t noticed a difference, so I’m 98% sure that the changes were due to the Toner. The cost is not amazing, but I think fair, so I’m happy with this! I’m really happy with the results!

So I’ve never used a toner in my whole life. This is the first one I have tried. I wouldn’t say I have extremely sensitive skin, but whenever I use new products it tends to irritate me or “burn” I was a little hesitant to use this. My skin will also turn red just by getting a facial so a light bulb clicked and I just figured I had “sensitive” skin. Anyways, read a lot of reviews and decided to try this. I am on my second bottle now and I am obsessed. The picture I attached does not do it justice because before I tried this, I was breaking out so much!! Especially around my chin around. This has really helped with my pores, making them smaller. It’s helped overall smooth my complexion. And the best part…. Helped with my break outs!! It’s very rare that I get a pimple now. I haven’t had any new breakouts. Just working on taking all my scarring and hyperpigmentation away. I wash my face with water in the morning, follow up with this on a cotton pad and moisturizer . And at night just use my cleanser, this and moisturizer and it’s totally changed the game for me! I will definitely continue to get this over and over.

avis.titre: Subtle but Strategic — Pairs Best with the PC Line
avis.texte: This isn’t the Ozempic of facial care — results won’t be dramatic overnight — but they’ll show up after a month or so. I use it at night, swiped with a cotton round post-shower, and I’ve noticed fewer breakouts and less midday/late night shine across my T-zone. The formula is thin, scent-free, and disappears without leaving residue — which I prefer. One bottle lasts me the full year with regular use, and the cap seals tight for travel without leaks. I’m 40 now and adhere to a minimalist routine — and this fits right in. Highly recommend pairing with the PC BHA counterpart for maximum benefit. — Curated by Jaded John | #OrderlyCleanDesign
